product.name: Copper Runtime
product.description: A GPLv3-compatible, Termux-derived native runtime for Copper Android builds. It is not branded as Termux and does not require the separately installed Termux app.

termuxPackages.license: Package recipes and resulting packages have their own licenses; each redistributed package must retain its applicable notices.

copperTarget.projectMirror: not-enabled-by-default; future opt-in temporary mirror must be deleted after a completed or cancelled build

securityModel.manualTerminal: Persistent PTY sessions using the installed runtime and Android shared-storage permission after explicit user approval.
securityModel.agentTools: Separate workspace-bound API. Do not expose the unrestricted manual terminal process to the AI tool registry.
securityModel.warning: A same-app path wrapper is a product boundary, not a kernel-grade containment boundary. Android does not offer an unprivileged chroot/container that makes an arbitrary native shell both fully capable and provably restricted to one SAF tree.
